## Stock Futures and Treasury Yields After the CPI Print


According to[TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/stock-futures-fall-as-september-cpi-data-spooks-investors) , Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.60%, S&P 500 futures were down 0.28% and Dow futures were down 0.15% as of 8:44 a.m. EDT on Wednesday. The 10-year Treasury yield rose 9 basis points to 5.306%, and the 30-year yield climbed 5 basis points to 5.612%, keeping attention on[how the yield curve is shifting](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/the-yield-curve-explained/) .


Index trackers such as the[SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/spy/) and the[Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/qqq/) follow those benchmarks. Bank earnings added to the morning's moves: TipRanks reported Bank of America fell about 4% before the open after a regulatory fine of more than $1.2 billion and[third-quarter results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/q3-bank-earnings-kick-off-season-goldman-jpmorgan-citi-bofa-12b-fine/) that missed expectations.

## What Does the September CPI Mean for the Fed?


It has pushed traders toward pricing a rate hike. As reported by[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-fall-as-hot-inflation-revives-fed-hike-concerns-4950317) , CME FedWatch odds of a quarter-point hike at this month's meeting rose to nearly 34% from about 29% on Thursday, after producer prices also came in hot.


Per[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-fall-as-hot-inflation-revives-fed-hike-concerns-4950317) , headline producer prices rose 1.3% in September against a 0.3% estimate, the largest monthly gain in about four and a half years. "Every category of business inflation was hot, even after stripping away energy costs," Heather Long, chief economist at Navy Federal, said, suggesting the fight against inflation will likely take longer than people want.


Technology shares bore much of the pressure on Thursday. Investing.com reported the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.5% at the open, with chipmakers including[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) among the decliners, while the Dow rose 0.6%.


## When Is the Next CPI Report?


The October CPI is scheduled for Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, according to the[BLS](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/cpi.htm) . Before that, the[Federal Reserve's calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm) shows the FOMC meeting on October 27-28, followed by a December 8-9 meeting that includes a Summary of Economic Projections.
